name: Baldwin County, GA
findings: Baldwin County has 96 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Baldwin County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Baldwin County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list public events
observations.text: 2 religious organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through religious groups? Where else does that happen?
